leads.title: General Inspectorate of Justice of Santa Catarina - Resolution of 29 April 2013
leads.documents: Allows same-sex marriage statewide, establishing same-sex family-union legal status before national STF legalization.
leads.detail: Published 29 April 2013 per article text; no URL visible in text

leads.title: State Law No. 12,534 / Complementary Law No. 656 - Legislative Assembly of Santa Catarina
leads.documents: 2003 state ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity and its repeal, defining state anti-discrimination machinery.
leads.detail: Enacted 4 April 2003; repealed 8 October 2015 by Complementary Law No. 656; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Complementary Law No. 527 - Governor Leonel Pavan / STF challenge
leads.documents: 2010 state ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity, 2015 lawsuit by Governor Raimundo Colombo, and STF partial overturn on labor-law competence grounds.
leads.detail: Signed 28 December 2010; challenged 2015; STF partially overturned 11 October 2018; 2019 STF ban on SOGI discrimination; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court (STF) - 1 March 2018 gender identity ruling
leads.documents: Right of transgender person to change official name and sex by self-declaration without surgery or professional evaluation.
leads.detail: Ruled 1 March 2018; no URL visible in text

leads.title: State Law No. 19,686/2026 - Governor Jorginho Mello (Liberal Party)
leads.documents: Requires all educational institutions public or private to maintain strictly separate male and female restrooms and changing rooms, directly affecting trans access.
leads.detail: Signed 21 January 2026; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Court of Justice of Santa Catarina / Supreme Federal Court - Florianopolis shopping mall restroom case 2014-2024
leads.documents: Documented incident: trans woman denied women's restroom in 2014; lower court awarded 15,000 reais, overturned by TJSC, appeal to STF in 2015 halted by Justice Luiz Fux, STF voted 8-3 on 6 June 2024 to reject appeal as non-constitutional.
leads.detail: Lower court 15,000 reais award; TJSC reversal; STF 8-3 rejection 6 June 2024; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Extraordinary appeal to Inter-American Court of Human Rights - Paulo Iotti, Associacao Nacional de Travestis e Transexuais, Associacao Brasileira de Lesbicas, Gays, Bissexuais, Travestis, Transexuais e Intersexos
leads.documents: August 2025 challenge to STF and Court of Justice of Santa Catarina restroom decisions, plus CartaCapital article and Aos Fatos fact-check context.
leads.detail: Filed August 2025; Iotti CartaCapital article 7 July; Rep. Paulo Bilynskyj X post debunked by Aos Fatos; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Brazilian Public Security Yearbook 2024 / Associacao Nacional de Travestis e Transexuais (ANTRA)
leads.documents: Government and human-rights enforcement data: 85 cases of intentional bodily injury against LGBTQ individuals and three murders of trans people in Santa Catarina in 2024.
leads.detail: 2024 yearbook and ANTRA count cited; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Agencia Diadorim - research/report on Santa Catarina
leads.documents: 19 anti-LGBTQ bills introduced in Legislative Assembly as of 2025 with 11 authored by Liberal Party (PL), and assessment that low violence rates result from underreporting.
leads.detail: 2025 count cited; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Office of Florianopolis Councilor Leonel Camasao (PSOL) - 2026 report
leads.documents: 271 unconstitutional laws processed in Santa Catarina legislative houses since 2015 against women's or LGBTQ rights, about 70% involving trans and travesti community, 41% topics ruled unconstitutional by STF, from Alesc and municipal councils.
leads.detail: 2026 report cited; no URL visible in text
